scripts.dev: npm run tokens && DELIVERABLES_ALLOW_LOCAL=1 astro dev
scripts.check:fixtures: npm run tokens && SITE_FIXTURES=1 astro build --outDir dist-fixtures && SITE_DIST=dist-fixtures CHECK_PAGES=/fixtures/parts/,/fixtures/parts/references/ EXPECT_MOUNT_FAILURES=broken EXPECT_MOUNT_SHIFTS=grows sh -c 'node tools/check-fixtures.ts && node tools/check-perf.ts && node tools/check-a11y.ts'
scripts.build:pages: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run tokens && astro build && pagefind --site dist --exclude-selectors .refs
scripts.build: npm run check:types && npm run check:english && npm run check:spec && npm run check:legacy && npm run check:fixtures && npm run build:pages && npm run check:icons && npm run check:perf && npm run check:a11y && npm run archive:merge && npm run check:urls
scripts.deploy:upload: npm run build && sh tools/cloudflare.sh node tools/deploy.ts upload
